title: Minister of Justice Meets with Team to Strengthen Access to Justice for All
summary: The Minister of Justice held a meeting with a project team focused on enhancing comprehensive access to justice, ensuring that the legal system is inclusive and accessible to people with disabilities and other marginalized groups.
body:
